claim_dispositions.mathematical_statement: The marked rank-four lattice has invariant form coefficients (3,1,0,-2,0,-2), contraction i_delta xi=-6 psi, and Smith factors (1,1,6,6).
claim_dispositions.proof_or_counterexample: Integer basis matrix has determinant -1 and congruence J plus 6J; contraction and all determinantal divisors checked.
claim_dispositions.residual_obligation: No new proof of the full complex-threefold construction is claimed.

claim_dispositions.mathematical_statement: ker(psi)/Z delta is a unimodular alternating plane.
claim_dispositions.proof_or_counterexample: The displayed unimodular basis restricts to J plus zero on ker(psi); quotient removes exactly the primitive radical.
claim_dispositions.confidence: Proof supplied in the named manuscript scope; independent acceptance pending.

claim_dispositions.mathematical_statement: The discriminant pairing gives a six-dimensional irreducible finite Heisenberg representation; it does not specify vertex operations or a physical theory.
claim_dispositions.proof_or_counterexample: Pairing is induced by inverse alternating form; character projectors and translations prove irreducibility. The doubled presentation gives a separate general finite carrier.
claim_dispositions.residual_obligation: A VOA/QFT application still requires fields, products, state spaces, anomaly and sewing comparisons.
claim_dispositions.confidence: Proof supplied in the named manuscript scope; independent acceptance pending.

claim_dispositions.mathematical_statement: The two-fibre presentation has first Smith divisor d=gcd(r,s,m,n), determinant Delta=rn+sm-rsb0, and a free summand when Delta=0.
claim_dispositions.proof_or_counterexample: New quotient and doubled forms use this actual matrix. All 38720 chosen integer cases satisfy the determinantal-divisor calculations.
claim_dispositions.residual_obligation: Formal non-effective data do not define primitive meridional fillings.
claim_dispositions.confidence: Proof supplied in the named manuscript scope; independent acceptance pending.

claim_dispositions.mathematical_statement: For effective rank-one data, the primitive coarse carrier is lcm(r,s), with coefficient Delta/gcd(r,s).
claim_dispositions.proof_or_counterexample: Kollar Propositions 43,47 and Corollary 44 supply the sheaf and differential. The new filtration sequence has cyclic middle H2 of order |Delta|.
claim_dispositions.residual_obligation: Transport to an arbitrary affine torus fibration still requires an actual map of constructible sheaves.
claim_dispositions.confidence: Proof supplied in the named manuscript scope; independent acceptance pending.

claim_dispositions.mathematical_statement: The global class has torsion invisible to its rational degree.
claim_dispositions.proof_or_counterexample: Bezout coordinates give epsilon=kU+tT with gT=0, k=Delta/g, t=bm-an. The quotient gives all Smith factors and a split extension exactly when gcd(g,k) divides t.
claim_dispositions.residual_obligation: No canonical identification of algebraic and Leray filtrations is asserted; their cyclic factors occur in opposite orders.
claim_dispositions.confidence: Proof supplied in the named manuscript scope; independent acceptance pending.

claim_dispositions.mathematical_statement: Effective two-fibre linking needs oriented meridional slopes in addition to the group order.
claim_dispositions.proof_or_counterexample: With m alpha+r beta=1, q=s beta-(n-sb0) alpha, the meridian relation is mu1=q mu0+Delta lambda0. Disk chain D1-qD0-B gives linking -q/Delta.
claim_dispositions.residual_obligation: This symmetric torsion form is attached to the explicit oriented three-manifold, not to an arbitrary presentation or to Engel H1 of the smooth torus fibre.
claim_dispositions.confidence: Proof supplied in the named manuscript scope; independent acceptance pending.

claim_dispositions.mathematical_statement: An alternating pairing for the general two-fibre arithmetic exists on the doubled cokernel, with full invariant factors.
claim_dispositions.proof_or_counterexample: The block matrix (0,A;-A^T,0) has elementary divisors (d,|Delta|/d); its inverse gives x^T A^-T y-prime minus x-prime^T A^-T y. At rank drop, quotient by the primitive radical gives dJ.
claim_dispositions.residual_obligation: The doubled lattice is an explicit arithmetic construction; a geometric comparison is not supplied.
claim_dispositions.confidence: Proof supplied in the named manuscript scope; independent acceptance pending.

claim_dispositions.mathematical_statement: Primitive torsion does not guarantee a free local affine action.

claim_dispositions.confidence: Proof supplied in the named manuscript scope; independent acceptance pending.
